title: Ijwi Rivuye mu Kuzimu
intro: Inkuru y’ukwihangana n’imbabazi zitagira aho zigarukira z’Ubumana irasohoka muri Korowani. Harungitswe intumwa mu gisagara gikomeye, ariko abantu babo baranka iyo ngabisho, banka ukuri. Mu gucika intege, uwo mutima waragiye — gusa kugira ngo ugeragezwe n’ikiyaga cari giteye ubwoba, maze umirane mu mwiza w’imbere cane. Mu nda y’umwiza, haradutse ugusaba kwicishije bugufi, maze Munyakigongwe aravyishura. Uwo mutima wasohotse wahindutse, abantu bawo boba abemera barenga ibihumbi ijana ni nde?
clues: Narungitswe kuba umugabisha mu gisagara gikomeye abakibamwo bari barazimiye bakava mu nzira y’ukwizera.
Nahamagaye abantu banje mu kuri incuro nyinshi, ariko baratwenga, banka ubutumwa bwanje.
Narabavuyeko nshavuye imbere y’uko bampa uruhusha, maze nca ngenda n’ikiyaga.
Haciye haba igihuhusi gikomeye, maze ndajugunywa mu kiyaga — hanyuma ndamirwa n’ikiremwa kinini co mu kiyaga.
Mu bice vy’umwiza — mu binogo vy’ikiyaga, mu nda y’ico gikoko, no mu binogo vy’ikiyaga — narasemerera nti: ‘Nta mana iriho atari Wewe; ubuninahazwa bube kuri Wewe; Nari mu bacumuzi.’
Allah yarankijije mu binogo, maze ngarutse, abantu banje barenga ibihumbi ijana bari bakiriye ukuri.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
